levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: New options are the same kind of change as the original two (e.g., a bigger, smaller, or rescheduled version).

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least two new options change a different dimension of the plan than the original two did.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: New options each change a different dimension from each other, as well as from the originals.

criteria.dimension: Explaining what makes an option distinct

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Explanation restates the option without saying what makes it different.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Explanation names the specific dimension that changed.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Explanation compares the new option directly to both originals, not just one.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reflection doesn't identify what a two-option frame would miss.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Reflection names a plausible thing the character would have missed.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Reflection connects the missed thing to a specific option that was later generated.

lookFors: At least two new options are present and are not resized or rescheduled versions of the original two.
The fixed-choice self-check on 'genuinely distinct vs. variation' is answered consistently with the actual option written.
The reflection ties the risk of narrow framing to something concrete from this scenario.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
